intro: Financial services and government sectors bore the brunt of a concentrated phishing campaign between April 8 and May 3, 2026, with 55 articles cataloging 47 high-severity and 8 medium-severity incidents. Threat actors Silver Fox, AccountDumpling, and Bluekit were observed exploiting vulnerabilities including CVE-2023-22515, CVE-2023-34048, CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2023-4966, and CVE-2024-21893, with impacts spanning global targets as well as Latin America, Canada, the Caribbean, and the United States.
